tool_args.command:
cat > /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/run_olmo2_s0.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -x
TRAIN_SCRIPT=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/train_sft.py
DATA_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/sft_data
CKPT_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2

MODEL_OLMO=/root/autodl-tmp/models/OLMo-2-1124-7B
for d in 000 005 025 050 100; do
  OUTDIR="${CKPT_DIR}/OLMo-2-7B_d${d}_s0"
  if [ -f "${OUTDIR}/train_config.json" ]; then
    echo "=== SKIP OLMo-2-7B dosage=${d} seed=0 (already exists) ==="
    continue
  fi
  echo "=== Starting OLMo-2-7B dosage=${d} seed=0 at $(date) ==="
  HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 \
  /root/miniconda3/bin/python "$TRAIN_SCRIPT" \
    --model-name "$MODEL_OLMO" \
    --data-path "${DATA_DIR}/sft_dosage_${d}.jsonl" \
    --output-dir "$OUTDIR" \
    --seed 0 \
    --lora-r 16 --lora-alpha 32 --lr 5e-5 \
    --batch-size 2 --grad-accum 8
  echo "=== Finished OLMo-2-7B dosage=${d} seed=0 at $(date), exit code=$? ==="
done
echo "ALL_DONE_OLMO2_S0"
EXIT_CODE=$?
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/run_olmo2_s0.sh
